events.notes: Button/form submit intent; credential values remain ephemeral and inaccessible to generic event/telemetry
Provider ID must be allowlisted by trusted config; no arbitrary URL
Browser ceremony only after app/provider invocation
OTP/recovery secret never serialized in global event payload
Provider/server decides rate limit and whether identity exists
Cancels presentation, not necessarily server challenge or session
Allowed only when trusted safe retry metadata says retryable
Never claim session revoked until server acknowledgement
Tenant context never changed solely by skin/UI state
Must be confirmed by server before success label
Opaque trusted destination ID; app validates allowlist
